description: Death replay for crawler_warren. Takes the corridor crystal and digs into the pocket above the ring corridor (safe: it is on the crawler's right). Waits until the crawler comes up the right side to the ring's top corner (tick 120), then steps down into the corridor in its path (tick 121). The crawler moves one cell closer (tick 126), then into the player, catching them (tick 132). Status dead; the cave freezes at tick 133.
